title: Hands-on with Galaxy S26 Ultra's Privacy Display: very impressive with a dual-pixel system that allows users to toggle viewing angles to prevent side-peeking (Allison Johnson/The Verge)
summary: Allison Johnson / The Verge: Hands-on with Galaxy S26 Ultra's Privacy Display: very impressive with a dual-pixel system that allows users to toggle viewing angles to prevent side-peeking — New hardware features? At a time like this? … Maybe it's a reflection of just how slow hardware innovation has been …
